title: Human resources manager
description: JOB OVERVIEW:  The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.  ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:  Talent Development & Retention  Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.  Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.  Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.  Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.g., workshops, speakers, Ed Camps).  Attracting & Retaining Talent  Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.  Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.  Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.  Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.  Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.  Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.  Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.  Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture  Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.  Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.  Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.  Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.  Compliance and Child Protection  Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.  Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws  Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).  Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.  Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.  Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.  Wellbeing  Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.  Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.  Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.  Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.  Health (physical and mental/emotional) Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.  Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.  Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.  Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.  Other duties, as assigned.  POSITION REQUIREMENTS  BA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field 5+ years of experience  HR policies, procedures, and best practices  Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA) HR Information Systems (HRIS) Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle  Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking  Professional development and training frameworks  Child protection and safeguarding protocols  Cultural competence and sensitivity.  Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in Portuguese  Other Skills (Desirable):  Excellent communication (verbal and written) Strong organizational and time management abilities  High attention to detail  Problem-solving and conflict resolution  Interpersonal skills and empathy  Confidentiality and discretion  Data analysis  Adaptability and proactivity  Cultural awareness and sensitivity  Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Preschool teaching assistant (maternity cover)
description: JOB OVERVIEW:  The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.  Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.  ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:  Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.  Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.  Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.  Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.  CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:  Instructional Support and Student Learning  Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.  Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.  Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.  Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.  Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.  Student Care and Learning Environment  Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.  Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).  Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.  Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.  Operational and School Support  Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.  Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.  Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.  Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.  Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.  Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.  Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.  Professional Conduct and Growth  Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.  Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.  Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.  Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.  Additional Responsibilities  Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.  Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.  Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.  Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.  Working Conditions  Walk on paths and rough terrain  Lifting backpacks and school materials  Other duties, as assigned.  POSITION REQUIREMENTS:  Degree in Pedagogy, preferred  Five years experience working with children, preferred  PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred) English level required: B2 or above  Portuguese level required: B2 or above  Other Skills (Desirable):  Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect  Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment  Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills  Strong professional organization skills  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.  We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.  At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy. Ledn values integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy. We are remote-friendly and operate globally.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities
  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads using AWS Nitro Enclaves; integrate with KMS and secure APIs; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments; ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience.
  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.
What You Bring To Ledn
  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Strong Linux internals knowledge and ability to remediate vulnerabilities identified in penetration tests.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.
Nice To Haves
  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.
Culture Fit
  • We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values: integrity, progress, empathy.
The Ideal Candidate Will
  • Have a passion for progress, be adaptable and resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.
What We Provide
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package, including generous PTO and ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote work options up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career and a remote-first, globally distributed team.
  • Commitment to equal opportunity and inclusivity; accommodation requests are welcome and confidential.

Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, recentemente a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

A Transzilli é uma empresa com 35 anos de experiência no transporte de cargas secas, refrigeradas e congeladas por todo o território nacional. Oferecemos as melhores soluções para atender às necessidades específicas de cada cliente. Nosso compromisso é garantir a eficiência, a segurança e a pontualidade na entrega das cargas.

Descrição do Cargo

Estamos em busca de um Condutor de Veículos Pesados (Truck) para nossa equipe em São Paulo. As responsabilidades diárias deste cargo incluem conduzir caminhões na rota do Mato Grosso do Sul.   • Regulamentações: Conhecimento das regulamentações do DOT para transporte rodoviário e compliance.

Principais atividades
  • Operar Centro de Usinagem Litz e outras diversas furadeiras radiais.
  • Realizar a preparação da peça para banho, aplicando substância desmoldante, utilizando pincel ou vassoura, bem como realizar a inspeção quanto à fixação de calços e feltros, conforme procedimentos preestabelecidos.
  • Auxiliar no processo de curagem da peça antes e depois dos banhos, conforme orientação e procedimentos preestabelecidos.
  • Auxiliar na instalação/fixação o dispositivo no Autoclave.
  • Identificar o dispositivo necessário para a realização dos banhos para cada tipo de peça, verificando a disponibilidades do mesmo ou solicitando sua fabricação, junto à área de projetos, conforme procedimentos preestabelecidos.
  • Realizar o processo de curagem da peça antes e depois dos banhos, acondicionando-a na estufa, acionando os comandos de temperatura e tempo, bem como acompanhando o processo, conforme procedimentos preestabelecidos.
  • Preparar e operar Prensa Dobradeira de pequeno, médio e grande porte, de maneira autônoma, instalando e ajustando ferramental conforme a especificação dos planos de preparação, posicionando a peça, efetuando ajustes de pressão e acionando comandos necessários às operações de moldagem de chapas grossas, baseado em instruções contidas em ordens de produção, desenhos, fichas de processo e procedimentos do sistema da qualidade.
  • Realizar a coleta de amostras do verniz utilizado no processo e enviar para análise química do laboratório de controle de qualidade, bem como, quando especificado em laudo, efetuar a correção do verniz, adicionando produtos especificados.
  • Preparar e operar Torno Horizontal CNC, programando, instalando e ajustando ferramentas conforme a especificação dos planos de preparação.
  • Realizar a programação Pantógrafo CNC, de acordo com o desenho disponibilizado pela engenharia, determinando as operações necessárias, conforme o trabalho a ser realizado.
  • Calcular as dimensões do traçado a ser realizado, utilizando os meios de medição mais adequados (réguas, escalas, calibradores, paquímetro, micrômetro, altímetro, dentre outros), a fim de determinar o local dos pontos e linhas de referência.

title: Full/Senior Product Manager Software
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Torizon is a Linux-based industrial IoT platform that simplifies modern iterative development, maintenance, and operation of distributed edge devices. It is a scalable full-stack DevOps-oriented solution, seamlessly integrating device hardware & software (including a Linux OS), development tools, cloud-based remote updates & fleet management, for high reliability and security applications.

Job Description

As a Full/Senior Product Manager – Software, you will be part of the Product & Technology ( P&T ) group, driving key product initiatives across Toradex’s software portfolio — from embedded Linux to cloud-based tools and services. You will co-own product areas with the PM Software Team end-to-end, from ideation to delivery, ensuring they align with the broader product vision and strategy defined by the company.

You will collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams to define priorities, shape product roadmaps, and deliver impactful solutions to our customers. While reporting to the PM Team Lead, you will play a leadership role within the team by influencing direction and fostering cross-functional alignment.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives on ownership, strategic thinking, and hands‑on execution within a highly technical and collaborative environment.

This role involves prioritizing and executing multiple initiatives in parallel, highlighting your independence and ability to drive several product areas simultaneously.

  • Own and drive one or more product areas or initiatives end-to-end, from discovery to delivery.
  • Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to validate product direction and gather feedback.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to define product vision, strategy, and success metrics.
  • Translate customer and business needs into clear, actionable product requirements.
  • Prioritize initiatives and maintain product roadmaps aligned with company strategy.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to ensure timely, high‑quality releases.
  • Define, track, and analyze key product indicators to inform future decisions.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of product management processes and tools.
  • Represent the product internally and externally, effectively communicating vision and progress.
Desired Candidate ProfileMandatory:
  • Strong ownership mindset with a record of driving initiatives independently.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non‑technical teams.
  • Solid understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile, and product management methodologies.
  • Proven experience as a Product Manager or similar role (3–5+ years preferred).
  • An analytical and data‑driven approach to decision‑making.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into customer value.
Nice to have:
  • Experience with embedded Linux, DevOps, or IoT platforms.
  • Familiarity with Software as a Service (SaaS) business models.
  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure, OTA updates, and device management.
  • Experience with developer tools, issue tracking (e.g., Jira), and analytics platforms.
  • Prior experience collaborating closely with engineering teams on technical products.
Willing to learn:
  • Deep technical aspects of Toradex software stack, including TorizonCore, Torizon Cloud, and related tooling.
  • Scaling product processes in a globally distributed organization.
  • Advanced techniques for roadmap definition, metrics analysis, and stakeholder management.
What we offer
  • Opportunity to influence Toradex’s software roadmap and overall product strategy.
  • Agile, globally oriented, and inter‑cultural corporate culture.
  • Exposure to leading‑edge embedded and IoT technologies.
  • Flat hierarchy where you can shape and influence your work processes.
  • Autonomy to own and drive product initiatives with real business impact.
  • Collaboration with an experienced, highly skilled engineering and PM team.
  • Variety of knowledge‑sharing, training, and self‑development opportunities.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space, and a flexible working environment.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature‑rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self‑driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Sobre a ODONTOCLINIC

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Fomos eleitos, por seis anos consecutivos, como a clínica com o melhor atendimento do Brasil no segmento odontológico pelo Reclame Aqui.

Aqui, valorizamos o desenvolvimento de pessoas como caminho para resultados sustentáveis. Investimos em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento. AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

The Principal Data Engineer will play a pivotal role in the technical leadership of data engineering projects, actively collaborating with data teams to identify and implement improvement opportunities. You'll be responsible for establishing architecture and quality standards, programming and monitoring pipeline routines, and validating code, dedicating at least 50% of your time to code reviews and technical evaluations. Beyond coding, your role will include mentoring developers on technical decisions, striving to optimize the team's "ways of working," and constantly identifying opportunities for improvement in the data environment and architecture. You'll work on designing and implementing scalable data pipelines and robust architectures, ensuring business demands are translated into efficient technical solutions. You'll also optimize existing pipelines, drive data collection strategies, and foster collaboration with cross-functional teams, in addition to contributing to data warehouse and data lake architecture.

  • Advanced SQL proficiency (hard skills).

  • Hands-on experience with Databricks .

title: Manager of Data and AI Transformation
description:
Join to apply for the Manager of Data and AI Transformation role at AB InBev

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

The AB InBev Strategy and Insights team is looking for a Manager of Data and AI Transformation with a strong knowledge on both technical data capabilities and business adoption. This role is integral to advancing the company's strategic priorities in AI and data within the function. The individual will connect business strategy with technical execution to improve the accessibility, actionability of the data to facilitate faster and better generation of insights. In this global position, the individual will have to collaborate with cross-functional teams, collaborate with senior stakeholders, and oversee the implementation of transformative programs across various markets.

What you'll do:

  • Define a clear 5-Year data and AI strategy for the Strategy & Insights team, build a roadmap broken down to key initiatives for every quarter, and drive execution of the plan in partnership with Marketing Technology, Global Analytics Center (GAC), and Product teams based in Brazil.
  • Understand business priorities to translate them to AI/data roadmap to drive measurable impact on the S&I insights generation capability.
  • Oversee the coordination of global AI and Data Ops initiatives for strategy & insights to ensure alignment, timely delivery, and acceleration, and automation of insights generation.
  • Engage with external AI vendors, startups, and technology partners to evaluate capabilities, pilot innovative solutions, and identify the best-fit partners for AB InBev’s transformation needs.
  • Provide architectural direction for data and data lake solutions to enable scalable AI/analytics applications.
  • Ensure data structures support marketing and commercial business use cases effectively.
  • Serve as a liaison between engineering, product, and business teams—bridging technical feasibility with strategic intent.
  • Develop executive-ready presentations and communication to drive engagement and organizational clarity on this key priority.
  • Lead change management efforts to enable the adoption of data/AI technologies across the organization, specifically engaging with the top 10 markets of ABI to drive adoption of the tools & data ecosystem.

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree or advanced certifications in AI/ML, Data Science, or Digital Transformation are highly desirable.
  • Experience in data transformation, analytics, or digital strategy roles—ideally with exposure to both data engineering and business delivery
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, including schemas, relational databases, materialized views, pipelines, ETL/ELT practices, and data governance.
  • Proven track record of leading enterprise-level transformation projects with senior leadership level visibility.
  • Strong understanding of cloud computing, automation, data governance, and AI/ML integration in enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on experience translating AI capabilities into measurable business impact.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams.
  • Background in management consulting or strategic roles in technology or CPG is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python, with the ability to explore datasets, support model deployment, and prototype data solutions in collaboration with technical teams.
  • Experience managing distributed, diverse teams in a global organization.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus
  • Attendance Bonus
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

Equal Opportunity & Affirmative Action:

AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon of race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

description:
Senior Onboarding and Compliance Processes

Join to apply for the Senior Onboarding and Compliance Processes role at Hedgepoint Global Markets

Hedgepoint operates across five continents, connecting local and global markets, helping to protect against price volatility in a world in transition. Offering over 450 hedging products across 50+ commodities and currencies (FX), we also provide market intelligence and specialized insights to help clients turn risk into opportunities. We value transparency and respect in all our relationships, whether with clients or employees, ensuring a unique experience in every interaction. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, valuing everyone for their uniqueness, without any form of discrimination.

Join our team and help us to turn risks into opportunities!

PURPOSE OF POSITION:

Analyst will optimize client and partner onboarding by designing, maintaining, and enhancing workflows and digital solutions. Leveraging data analysis and business intelligence tools, this role will streamline registration processes while ensuring strict compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

CORE COMPETENCES:

  • Onboarding Systems: Proficiency in onboarding software and digital KYC/KYP solutions to design system requirements, including checklists, forms, flows, etc.) and perform tests for implementation.
  • Regulatory: Knowledge of financial regulations and clients documents verifications.
  • Process Optimization: Skilled in business process mapping (BPMN) and redesign.
  • Risk and Control: Design internal controls for risk mitigation, including policies and procedures for Onboarding.
  • Project: End-to-end project management capabilities.
  • Data: Design and implement dashboards, detailed reports, and database integrity for recordkeeping.
  • Financial Sector Expertise: Understanding of financial services operations.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:

Design and execute end-to-end onboarding processes for clients and sales partners within financial services, ensuring compliance with global AML, Suitability, KYC, and KYP regulations, as well as internal policies. Support process optimization through requirements gathering, BPMN process mapping, data analysis, and testing and implementation of digital solutions. Produce and maintain client checklists, forms, and customer FAQ documentation. Assess operational risks, establish appropriate controls, develop and maintain relevant policies and procedures, assist the onboarding team, and facilitate effective communication among Compliance, Credit, Legal, IT, and Sales departments for onboarding solutions. Design, test, and deploy compliant and efficient workflows to enhance the overall customer experience.

ACTIVITIES DETAILS:

  • Analyze applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies , converting them into clear checklists, forms, and operational procedures.
  • Develop and continuously optimize onboarding workflows , including creating flow diagrams and checklists for required documentation.
  • Develop, revise, and maintain internal policies, standard operating procedures, manuals, and support materials , including FAQs for clients and partners.
  • Integrate regulatory requirements and internal guidelines into onboarding processes (Know Your Client – KYC and partner - KYP).
  • Review and understand individuals and corporate documents, to design onboarding verifications and analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Client Services, Compliance, Legal, and Credit teams to gather necessary documentation and information for electronic KYC and KYP records.
  • Identify, assess, and support the onboarding processes ensuring adherence to internal and external regulations.
  • Design and implement analytical models, interactive dashboards, and detailed reports to support strategic and operational decisions.
  • Configure and maintain onboarding systems , ensuring accurate technical setup.
  • Draft technical requirements and perform testing of technology solutions implemented in onboarding-related systems.
  • Liaise with key platform partners to align onboarding processes, mitigating risks and delays.
  • Create training materials and conduct training sessions for internal teams.
  • Ensure integrity, maintenance, and regular updates of client and partner databases , performing audits to ensure data accuracy.
  • Stablish controls for documentation and clients’ information in accordance with internal policies and regulatory standards.
  • Continuously monitor onboarding performance , identify gaps, propose data-driven solutions, and develop structured action plans.
  • Register client information into internal systems , monitor account opening requests, and proactively communicate progress to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Control and periodically review internal registrations and records , ensuring they are accurate and up to date

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) or higher in Information Technology, Automation Engineering, Law, Data Engineering, Regulatory Compliance, or related fields from top-tier universities.
  • Experience in financial markets.
  • Experience with CRM systems and databases (e.g., SQL, Salesforce).
  • Proficiency in data analysis.
  • Ability to create system requirements and conduct user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Advanced Excel; VBA is a plus).
  • Knowledge of BPMN and flowchart tools (e.g., Bizagi).
  • Familiarity with Python and AI applications for data analysis.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese.

Responsibilities and assignments

Job Description

Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️

A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E.
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Os projetos de eficiência energética realizam ações voltadas a eficiência energética em comunidades de baixa renda, além de beneficiar clientes residenciais com redução da conta de energia através do uso seguro e mais eficiente da energia elétrica. Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.
// Sobre a oportunidade

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenos e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de Campinas. Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024 com diversas senioridades na estrutura.Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto as áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

// Pré-requisitos:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset alllocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • CFP ou CGA ou CFG;

// Diferenciais:

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

// Modelo de trabalho:

  • Presencial em Campinas e proximidades.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass , Zenklub , VA, VR, New Value , seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. title: Especialista em Inteligência de Mercado
description:
Quem nós somos?

Na Pearson, nosso propósito é simples: ajudar as pessoas a realizarem a vida que imaginam por meio da aprendizagem. Acreditamos que toda oportunidade de aprendizado é uma chance de transformação pessoal. Somos a empresa de aprendizado ao longo da vida mais reconhecida do mundo. Para nós, aprender não é apenas o que fazemos. É quem somos.

Para saber mais:

Nossa Equipe: O time de Planejamento Estratégico tem como missão transformar dados e análises em decisões que impulsionem o crescimento da empresa. Atuamos de forma transversal com diversas áreas, estruturando metas, indicadores e processos comerciais para garantir previsibilidade, eficiência e foco em resultados. É um ambiente dinâmico, analítico e desafiador, ideal para quem busca aprender com profundidade sobre o negócio, ter impacto direto nas decisões e que tenha autonomia e visão estratégica.

Além de conectar estratégia e execução, somos responsáveis por gerar inteligência de mercado e insights estratégicos que apoiam a tomada de decisão em todos os níveis. É o lugar certo para quem gosta de investigar, compreender tendências, analisar concorrência e transformar informações em oportunidades reais de crescimento — com foco em Brasil e suas diferentes regiões , e com visão complementar para apoiar nossos projetos e operações internacionais.

Sobre a Função:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Inteligência de Mercado para fortalecer nosso time de Planejamento Estratégico. Se você é apaixonado(a) por análise de dados, pesquisa de mercado, comportamento do consumidor e geração de insights que impulsionam estratégias de negócio, essa é a oportunidade de fazer parte de uma equipe com alto impacto e visibilidade. Seu papel será liderar análises profundas sobre mercado, concorrência, consumidores e tendências, gerando inteligência acionável para decisões de expansão, posicionamento, crescimento sustentável e diferenciação competitiva. Atuará com foco prioritário em mercado brasileiro e segmentações regionais, apoiando também, quando necessário, análises estratégicas relacionadas à expansão do negócio fora do país.

Buscamos alguém com perfil investigativo, analítico e estratégico, que saiba traduzir dados complexos e de grandes volumes em histórias claras, recomendações sólidas e direcionamentos práticos para a companhia.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar pesquisas e análises estruturadas de mercado e concorrência, identificando oportunidades de crescimento, riscos potenciais e tendências emergentes.

  • Monitorar continuamente e reportar market share e evolução dos principais players, trazendo análises comparativas que subsidiem decisões de posicionamento e diferenciação.

  • Realizar estudos de expansão geográfica, avaliando potencial de novos mercados, tanto no Brasil quanto em outros países.

  • Desenvolver perfis comportamentais e segmentações de público-alvo, conectando insights de consumidor às estratégias comerciais e de marketing.

  • Produzir relatórios e apresentações executivas com insights claros, conectando informações de mercado à estratégia do negócio.

  • Manter acompanhamento contínuo de indicadores externos (demográficos, econômicos, educacionais e de consumo), transformando-os em inteligência de mercado de fácil interpretação e impacto direto no negócio.

  • Conduzir benchmarks e estudos comparativos, identificando gaps estratégicos e diferenciais competitivos.

  • Estruturar, organizar e evoluir bases de dados de inteligência de mercado, assegurando governança, confiabilidade e escalabilidade das informações.

  • Integrar dados de diferentes fontes (IBGE, ABF, Nielsen, Euromonitor, consultorias, concorrência e bases proprietárias) para gerar inteligência robusta, consistente e de alto valor estratégico.

  • Atuar como referência em research e insights na área de planejamento, apoiando times parceiros e influenciando diretamente a estratégia corporativa.

  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de marketing, expansão e finanças para alinhar informações de mercado às estratégias corporativas.

Para dar match com essa vaga, é importante que você tenha:

  • Fit com a cultura da nossa empresa.

  • Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Estatística, Marketing ou áreas afins.

  • Experiência sólida em inteligência de mercado, research ou planejamento estratégico .

  • Vivência com análise de concorrência, market share e comportamento do consumidor.

  • Experiência em estudos de expansão e potencial de mercado nacional, com foco em segmentações regionais .

  • Domínio em análise de dados e visualização com ferramentas como Excel avançado, Power BI, Python ou Google Looker Studio .

  • Facilidade em lidar com bases de dados diversas (demográficas, socioeconômicas, geográficas, etc.) e cruzar informações de diferentes fontes (IBGE, ABF, Nielsen, Euromonitor, etc.).

  • Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica para transformar dados complexos em insights práticos e acionáveis.

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para elaborar relatórios e conduzir apresentações executivas.

  • Perfil investigativo, organizado, proativo, com senso crítico, foco em resultado e trabalho colaborativo.

title: Product Security Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Overview

As a Product Security Engineer at Toradex, you’ll be responsible for the implementation, validation, and maintenance of security features in Toradex’s embedded software stack. That means hands‑on, low‑level work with bootloaders, Linux kernel security features, secure software updates and more.

We aim to make embedded software development easy and approachable, which means that our engineers have to go beyond just feature enablement. Your work will involve making the developer experience of working with low‑level security features as smooth as it possibly can be. You’ll work on systems used in critical industries like healthcare, industrial automation, and robotics.

Responsibilities
  • Security feature enablement: Bring up security features on new hardware. Every new product we release, we strive to have a uniform, straightforward experience for enabling basic hardware security features like secure boot, ARM TrustZone/ OP-TEE , and hardware‑backed encryption.
  • System-level hardening: Toradex maintains Torizon OS, a secure, production‑ready embedded Linux OS. Making sure that security features fit into the whole stack, and that configurations are secure‑by‑default for the most common and supported workflows is a key part of the job. Understanding how everything fits together is a must.
  • Vulnerability management: Monitor upstream CVEs, assess their impact on Toradex products and their likely impact on Toradex customers' products. Apply patches and mitigations. Help draft security advisories and write VEX documents. Work on and maintain internal tooling for vulnerability management.
  • Security testing and automation: Automate test coverage of security features. Familiarity with LAVA or other hardware‑in‑the‑loop embedded testing methodologies and frameworks is a strong plus.
Qualifications and Experience
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in embedded systems security or adjacent areas (e.g. Linux security engineering)
  • Hands‑on experience with bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), kernel security features, and embedded Linux distributions/build systems (Yocto/OpenEmbedded, buildroot, etc.)
  • Solid C/C++ coding and debugging skills
  • Experience with automating security checks in CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of threat modeling/risk modeling methodologies and how they relate to regulatory and standards compliance is a plus
  • Knowledge of security evaluation and analysis tools like fuzzers and static analysis tools is a plus
What we offer
  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self‑development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature‑rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self‑driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Why Soben? We're an award-winning construction consultancy with bold ambitions and a clear vision for the future. Since our founding in 2011, we've made significant progress, but now, we’re entering a new chapter of accelerated growth and transformation.

We are seeking a QA/QC Engineer to join our construction team in the Campinas–Hortolândia area . Overview

Na Swarovski, onde a inovação se encontra com a inspiração, nosso pessoal de caixa são os nossos defensores, que prestam aos clientes um serviço extraordinário e uma experiência de marca inspiradora.

Responsável por auxiliar o gerente de boutique em todas as tarefas administrativas respeitando a abordagem e estratégia empresarial para atingir objetivos de desempenho definidos em termos de vendas, bem como os objetivos qualitativos, incluindo a qualidade do serviço e aparência da boutique de acordo com a estratégia e política da Swarovski.

Sobre o cargo

Você é defensor(a) da nossa marca. Nesta função, e juntamente com a equipa, irá:

  • Realizar as tarefas de Contabilidade, emissão de NF série 01e D1 e enviar os documentos fiscais ao escritório/ Pryor (NF´s , leitura X e leitura z) a fim de garantir o funcionamento dos procedimentos fiscais na boutique.
  • Realizar as tarefas de TI, solicitar manutenção de equipamento ou suporte do sistema quando necessário.
  • Realizar as tarefas de RH, envio de escala de folgas e folha de ponto ao escritório
  • Informar através do email e fax, a chegada de boletos bancários na boutique, e enviar posteriormente ao setor de contas as pagar.
  • Outras tarefas de rotina da área
Sobre você

Você é Um(a) Pessoa De Caixa Excecional, Que Nos Oferece

  • um excelente sentido de moda e uma verdadeira paixão pela nossa marca e os nossos produtos;
  • experiência/forte interesse nas marcas de moda/cosmética/estilo de vida de luxo;
  • uma personalidade fortemente motivada e focada na orientação do cliente;
  • dedicação e atitude orientada por objetivos;
  • vontade de desenvolver a sua carreira e crescer conosco
O que oferecemos

Você pode esperar uma série de benefícios, incluindo:

  • Descontos em produtos Swarovski
  • Programa de Assistência ao Funcionário
  • Licença para voluntario
  • Programas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento
Sobre a Swarovski

A Swarovski produz produtos à base de cristal de qualidade e habilidade artística impecáveis que trazem alegria e celebram a individualidade. Fundada em 1895 na Áustria, a empresa desenha, fabrica e vende sofisticados cristais, pedras preciosas, diamantes e zircônias fabricadas e acessórios, bem como objetos de cristal e acessórios para a casa. A Swarovski Crystal Business tem alcance global com aproximadamente 2.400 lojas e 6.700 pontos de vendas em cerca de 140 países e emprega mais de 18.000 pessoas. Junto com suas empresas irmãs, a Swarovski Optik (dispositivos ópticos) e a Tyrolit (abrasivos), a Swarovski Crystal Business compõe o Swarovski Group. Uma relação saudável com as pessoas e com o planeta é parte da herança da Swarovski. Hoje, esse legado se fundamenta em medidas de sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia de valor, com ênfase na inovação circular, defendendo a diversidade, inclusão e autoexpressão, e no trabalho filantrópico da Swarovski Foundation, que apoia organizações de caridade que provocam um impacto ambiental e social positivo.

Swarovski é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades. Oferemos à nossa equipe a coragem de celebrar a individualidade e o orgulho de criar um local de trabalho onde as pessoas se sintam envolvidas, respeitadas, valorizadas, conectadas e ouvidas. Um lugar onde qualquer pessoa se sinta parte da empresa. Todos os aspectos do emprego, incluindo a decisão de contratar, promover, disciplinar ou demitir, serão baseados no mérito, competência, desempenho e necessidades do negócio. Não discriminamos com base em raça, cor, religião, estado civil, idade, nacionalidade, deficiência física ou mental, condição médica, gravidez, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero ou qualquer outro status protegido por lei nos países onde operamos.

title: Experienced UVM Verification Engineer
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.
What we offer you
  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

title: 30/12/2024 - Presidente sanciona regra que limita aumento do salário mínimo; veja valor
description:
Presidente sanciona regra que limita aumento do salário mínimo; veja valor

O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva sancionou a lei que estabelece um limite para o reajuste do salário mínimo, restringindo-o a até 2,5% acima da inflação entre 2025 e 2030. A medida integra o pacote de controle de despesas obrigatórias proposto pelo governo federal e aprovado pelo Congresso há cerca de dez dias.

Com a nova regra, o salário mínimo para 2025 deverá ser de R$ 1.518, um acréscimo de R$ 106 em relação ao valor atual de R$ 1.412. O número ainda será oficializado por decreto presidencial, a ser publicado nos próximos dias.

A medida busca alinhar o reajuste do salário mínimo ao novo arcabouço fiscal. Assim, os aumentos anuais serão limitados a uma faixa de 0,6% a 2,5% acima da inflação.

A política de correção do mínimo vigente desde 2023 será mantida, calculando-se o reajuste com base na soma da inflação acumulada pelo Índice Nacional de Preços ao Consumidor (INPC) até novembro e o crescimento do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) de dois anos anteriores. No entanto, o teto de 2,5% acima da inflação agora restringe a parcela adicional vinculada ao PIB.

Salário mínimo
A aprovação da lei no final do ano legislativo deverá gerar uma economia de R$ 15,3 bilhões nos próximos cinco anos. De acordo com a Lei de Diretrizes Orçamentárias, cada real de aumento no salário mínimo eleva os gastos federais em cerca de R$ 392 milhões, sobretudo devido à Previdência Social e a benefícios vinculados ao piso, como o Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC).


Sob as regras anteriores, o salário mínimo de 2025 seria de aproximadamente R$ 1.528, considerando a inflação acumulada de 4,84% e o crescimento do PIB de 3,2% em 2023. No entanto, com o teto imposto pela nova legislação, o reajuste foi ajustado para R$ 1.518.

O pagamento do novo salário mínimo começará no final de janeiro ou início de fevereiro de 2025, referente ao trabalho realizado no primeiro mês do ano.

Na Caedu nós trabalhamos com um propósito claro: Compartilhar o que temos de melhor para vestir histórias mais felizes. Para isso, respeitamos a diversidade, trabalhamos com senso de dono e queremos proporcionar o melhor para os nossos colaboradores e clientes SEMPRE!

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Realizar rondas diárias em todas as dependências da loja, principalmente nas áreas de riscos, como provadores, área de vendas, estoques e caixa.
  • Fiscalizar o setor de estoque quando do recebimento e envio de mercadorias e produtos, incluindo a chegada dos caminhões, recebimento, contagem e conferência de peças e equipamentos pelos operadores, controle dos coletores e notas fiscais, de modo a contribuir para a redução de perdas e riscos para a empresa.

  • Atuar de forma discreta na prevenção de roubos e furtos nas dependências internas, entradas e saídas da loja, observando atitudes suspeitas e delitos, utilizando rádio para comunicar, obter orientações e aplicar ações de acordo com as regras e procedimentos, de modo a minimizar os riscos para a empresa, informando à gerência.
  • Acompanhar o gerente e supervisores na abertura e fechamento da loja, fazendo rondas em todo o perímetro da mesma, bem como na chegada e saída do carro forte, contribuindo para a segurança do patrimônio e numerários.
  • Contribuir para a redução dos custos com consumo de água e energia, através de vistorias de hora em hora nos setores tomando ações para eliminar consumos desnecessários.
  • Acompanhar as imagens dos monitores de segurança (CFTV) nas dependências internas da empresa, verificando as ações, monitorando as ocorrências e efetuando as gravações e backups diários com o apoio da equipe de Prevenção de Perdas de modo a registrar todos os movimentos para controles, possíveis investigações e decisões corretivas pela empresa.

  • Realizar o controle de entrada e saída dos produtos nos provadores, observando e efetuando a entrega, conferência e recebimento de fichas junto aos clientes, registrando as intercorrências em formulários específicos, conforme orientações dos manuais.

  • Realizar o atendimento a clientes na área de vendas quando necessário, auxiliando e orientando sobre a localização dos produtos, promoções e oferecendo sacolas e cartões, contribuindo assim para a satisfação dos clientes e resultados da loja.
  • Atender o cliente com simpatia, agilidade e clareza nas informações, visando a satisfação dos mesmos e a oportunidade de comercialização dos produtos.
  • Cumprir a jornada de trabalho diária, conforme escala mensal e semanal sem cometer irregularidades nas marcações e seguindo a legislação e orientações do líder e supervisor.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo.

description:
Validation Specialist

A certified B Corp, OPTEL is one of the world's leading providers of traceability systems. Its mission is to use its innovative technologies to create a better world through responsible capitalism. The company's renowned solutions guarantee the quality of healthcare products and help combat the counterfeiting of drugs and medical devices around the world. OPTEL also adapts its technologies to different sectors—from healthcare to smart manufacturing and beyond—all of which can benefit from global traceability. OPTEL's expertise will enable various industries to measure, inspect, control, and track a wide variety of items to improve product quality and ensure more responsible use of resources.

Summary

The Validation Specialist is responsible for creating and updating validation documents (internal protocols, Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), Change Controls) to ensure that OPTEL systems comply with industry standards. This role requires strong expertise in documentation as well as the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and clients to ensure compliance, quality, and project reliability.

Please submit your resume in English.

Responsibilities

Validation Documentation and Management:

  • Develop and maintain standardized validation templates that comply with industry standards and regulatory requirements (GAMP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11).
  • Review and interpret system updates (new releases, patches) to assess their impact on validation documents.
  • Produce validation documents for clients based on functional and design specifications of projects.
  • Execute internal validation protocols as needed to ensure system functionality and compliance.

Risk Analysis and Quality Improvement:

  • Actively participate in risk assessments to identify validation-related issues and define necessary mitigation plans.
  • Identify root causes of validation nonconformities and deploy corrective actions with a focus on continuous quality improvement.

Collaboration and Expertise:

  • Coordinate with various internal departments to deliver validation documentation at key project milestones.
  • Advise internal teams and clients on best practices and validation strategies.
  • Work in collaboration with the Quality Assurance (QA) team to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards, including participation in internal and external audits.
  • Perform any other related tasks associated with validation processes.
Required Skills
  • College diploma in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in system validation/testing or technical writing.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English required.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel). Rigor, analytical mindset, and attention to detail. Ability to collaborate effectively in a team and communicate with stakeholders at all levels. Strong curiosity and willingness to learn and adopt new technologies, especially artificial intelligence.
